audio_caption: The clip starts with a male speaker enthusiastically stating that he's going to show how to upload videos to Instagram on PC, Mac, or computer, and that it will be free. He explains that he's made lots of videos on the subject and says that it would be nice if Instagram "actually created a really cool way of doing this". He reveals the solution will involve Instagram on PC and a bit of Facebook. As the speech ends, a heavy rock music riff plays.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker giving instructions on how to use a phone for "one simple, easy step". He says to go to Instagram, click on it, and go to your profile. He then indicates to click three horizontal lines at the top, saying you can even follow him "while you're here". He instructs listeners to click "settings" at the bottom, then "account", and finally, "switch account type". He concludes by saying, "click switch to business account", and explains you can then use Instagram on your PC to upload video and posts. The speaker then says, "right then, now we've done that."

The audio clip begins with a male speaker, using a friendly and encouraging tone, inviting the listener to "jump into the computer" and showing them how to upload videos on their PC, Mac, or computer. He asks the listener to subscribe and join the growing community at "Ben's Guide", because "we'd love to have you." He then says "Right then, let's dive in and get started."

The clip begins with a male speaker starting to explain something step-by-step, "go to Google...and type in Instagram Creator Studio." He adopts a calm tone, providing further instructions about finding "Facebook Creator Studio" and emphasizing the connection between the two. The speaker continues by addressing potential sign-in issues, advising what to do if the viewer is not already signed in. Finally, he mentions a "purple bar at the top" and instructs the viewer to "switch over to Instagram".

The clip begins with a male speaker, in an informative tone, outlining the various options available on the left-hand side of a screen, including calendar, insights to see your audience, monetization, account switching, and resources for Instagram shop management. He then shifts the focus to the most relevant feature, the "create post" button, highlighting the two options, Instagram feed and IGTV. The speaker then expresses that the rest of the clip will focus on the Instagram feed, clarifying that both options function identically.

The audio begins with one male speaker who's talking about clicking on an "Instagram feed", describing the experience and free way to do it. He says to "put in your description to start with, based on what your video is about," and "video hashtags." He mentions adding emojis and location, and finally adding content to your video. He notes the limited options for uploading a video from a PC or Mac. He explains that he uses "something called Lately Social."

The clip begins with a male speaker enthusiastically describing a "brilliant app" for social media management, praising its features like scheduling posts and uploading multiple photos. He suggests checking out "Lately Social" with a "20% off" discount via a link in the description, stating it's worthwhile for serious Instagram users because it takes care of all your social media needs with the feature of story carousels. He hopes his video has given the listener the answer they're looking for, explaining the free method of uploading videos to Instagram is a "great and viable solution" if you just put on posts "now and again". For more serious needs, he suggests "checking out Lately Social". Finally, he thanks the listeners for watching.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker expressing gratitude, saying "if it has been helpful, give me a thumbs up because that means a lot for supporting the channel." His tone is enthusiastic and encouraging. He continues by wishing the listeners a good day, saying "whatever you do for the rest of the day guys, make sure it's a good one, and I'll see you in the next video."
